scope: Parent-requested descriptive supplement. Created after primary attribution results, before computing these features. No thresholds/strategy fitting.
signal_time: First BUY trade.signal_at close, verified before opened; trade.floor is immutable original signal floor (not final layer.floor).
coordinate: Frozen source signal adjusted close only for pre-entry descriptive log returns and floor distance; within each feature window all source_kind, source_path, segment_id must be same, fresh valid observations required. No claim of PIT adjusted feed. Prices/amount missing -> UNKNOWN, never zero.
calendar: Use full date index of frozen 000001.SZ signal.parquet, truncated to study end; assert its dates from 2022-01-01 through end exactly equal original 1054 account dates. This permits 2021 lookback without truncating first entries.
comparison_groups: STALLED20_FINAL_LOSS = full round CLOSED, PnL<0, round_progress20=STALLED20; BIG_WINNER30 = full round CLOSED and original all-BUY-cost return>=30%. All other/open rows retained in full feature table; comparisons ALL,2022,2024 by actual first BUY year. No crossed threshold search.
summaries: Known/UNKNOWN counts, p10/25/50/75/90 per feature; IQR intersection over union and fraction of each group falling in other's p10..p90. Descriptive overlap only; no predictive/causal claim. Also first5 timing and initial-layer outcomes for both groups.
giveback: Optional posthoc continuous descriptive extension only: peak close vs terminal actual sell price, same cumulative recorded split coordinate; closed layer uses last sale part for that layer, round final actual sale. For OPEN terminal is latest held close not a hypothetical sale. Report decline from peak and whether final loss coexists, not executable peak profit.
primary_outputs: Do not modify existing definitions, primary tables or script.
